title: Raccoon wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <polygon points='50,12 36,38 64,38' fill='#ff3b7f'/>
  <polygon points='50,12 43,26 57,26' fill='#ffd23f'/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='26,34 20,14 40,24' fill='#6b6f8c'/>
  <polygon points='74,34 80,14 60,24' fill='#6b6f8c'/>
  <polygon points='28,31 23,20 37,26' fill='#d9a7b8'/>
  <polygon points='72,31 77,20 63,26' fill='#d9a7b8'/>

  <circle cx='63' cy='50' r='3.5' fill='#241f3a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='49' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='49' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- Nose and muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#e8e8f5'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='57' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#2e2440'/>

  <line x1='76' y1='63' x2='90' y2='61' stroke='#c9cce8' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='67' x2='89' y2='69' stroke='#c9cce8' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
